last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Tue 08-18, day 7 in country, lunch anchor. TABLE REHEARSAL, his pick, and the production axis moved after Saturday's zero. THREE COLD FIRES AND TWO CLOSED SLIPS. (1) podhum podhum — fired cold to stop Athai's ladle, with podunga and podren still in his ear from my own decomposition thirty seconds earlier. That is the exact discrimination that beat him on 08-14 (he asked for MORE when he meant STOP). chunk-not-machine tested LANDED. (2) naan bike-la varen — he caught a buried ask inside a fast cousin line (bike, or shall I pick you up?) and answered clean; frame:in-la on a novel slot, and the naan was CORRECT here because two options were live — the one place his person-marker habit earns its seat. (3) naan mudhalla maama-kitta kekkanum — obligation-num on a novel verb, and -kitta placed right. That is the 08-08 sentence he got wrong (naan maama sollanum) rebuilt correctly, unaided, in a scene that did not hand it over. person-marker tested LANDED. THE REPAIR LINE IS STILL THE HOLE, AND HE NAMED IT HIMSELF. Mission from 08-15 unfired: 'I did not have an opening and it is now cold in my mouth.' Round 1 then proved it live — Athai at full speed drew 'what's that?' IN ENGLISH, aimed at me. Not a bluff this time and not a freeze: the right instinct with no Tamil mouth on it. Same ledger line. The 08-15 episode dose was built and did not take, so the format changes — DRILL, mouth-reps, silence as the demand. TESTIMONY, UNPROMPTED, AND HE IS RIGHT: 'what happened to the coffee and lore at the start of our sessions? they disappeared without warning since sometime last week.' The break-first open eroded when I inverted the channel law on 08-12 (chat = decomposition + ambush). I optimised the middle and ate the door, silently. Logged verbatim; debt paid live with the podhum/podu carve (dental tha vs retroflex da — two roots, never twins; and podhu 'time' sits inside ippo and appo). Campaign block now protects the open explicitly. ALSO CORRECTED MYSELF ON THE RECORD: I told him he had not opened the morning knock. All the system sees is 'no reply' — nothing comes back from Apple Podcasts. He called it, and he was right to. STILL OPEN: english-word-order 2x, escalated, untested 9 days. Amma birthday ~Aug 24 — pirandha naal vazhthukkal is SEEN only, never fired, and the window is closing. TONIGHT'S MISSION: the ladle comes at every meal — when he is full, do not just stop her, take the spoon: naane eduthukkaren. Rides an event that cannot fail to happen, unlike the last one.

Permute the three repair lines across speeds and speakers; each one fired at him fast, then a real gap he must fill out loud. No scene, no teaching voice, no gloss — he does not need to understand it better, he needs it to arrive before the English does. Vary WHICH repair fits: innoru thadava sollunga (say that one thing again), konjam medhuva sollunga (slow down going forward), enna sonneenga? (reopen it). Never let two consecutive prompts want the same line.
